title: lfp condensedUpperStar
statement:
theorem lfp_condensedUpperStar
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))
    (hM : IsLocallyFinitelyPresented (condensedRingObj Λ X) M) :
    IsLocallyFinitelyPresented (condensedRingObj Λ Y)
      ((CondensedRing.upperStar Λ f).obj M). This is the exact Lean statement, with the definitions cited in stmt_deps.

proof.text: The existing raw inverse image preserves local finite presentation by pulling back a presentation cover. Transport the result along the inverse coefficient comparison, and use extendScalarsIsoComapInv to identify it with normalized pullback.

mathlib_searches.query: A pro-etale cover of a surjective closed subscheme has a refinement pulled back from a pro-etale cover of the ambient scheme
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits about etale pretopologies, etale morphisms and surjective singleton covers; no pro-etale closed-immersion model or covering-refinement theorem. The source library affine ind-etale closed-site lift supplies the missing geometry.
Twelve hits, including Surjective.of_comp and stability and iso instances. These support the geometric arguments but do not state finite-model transport or pro-etale cover lifting.

Twenty-five hits, including closed embeddings on prime spectra and the fact that a surjective closed immersion into a reduced scheme is an isomorphism. No pro-etale covering or module-presentation result.

mathlib_searches.query: A surjective closed immersion induces an equivalence on module sheaves on the pro-etale site, preserving locally finite presentation and finite coefficient models under restriction
mathlib_searches.results: 8 hits: AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion.toSurjectiveOnStalks, AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion.instIsIsoSchemeToImage, AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion.of_surjective_of_isAffine, AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrict_obj, AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion.spec_of_surjective, AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion.isAffine_surjective_of_isAffine, AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion.casesOn, AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion.instOfIsIsoScheme. No exact pro-etale module or support-induction theorem.
